title: Alcatraz Island Lighthouse
axis: +X northeast, +Z southeast, aligned to native principal-prison walls and photographed square lighthouse base. Own native tower centroid is the anchor.
source: Protomaps native building footprint and dry footway; original lighthouse polygon retained, physical square base constrained by photographs and1910 station inventory.
identityStatus: Native single lighthouse polygon; square base and octagonal upper tower corroborated by full local originals and1910 station inventory. Separate cellhouse, cistern and ruins excluded.
geometryLabel: 4.4m square own footing enclosing the original quantized native tower polygon. Historical base13ft9in controls4.191m wall width; narrow projecting footing is a photographic interpretation.

terrainContact.basis: Actual native dry footway vertex6.955m southwest of tower centroid, outside every extracted building footprint. Independent original USGS raster is resampled in this tower frame before geometry, without fitting or flattening.

Endpoints/epochs unspecified in modern overviews. Use historic dimension and photo proportions as an approximate current envelope, not a resolved surveyed current height.
controls.headingBasis: Native prison southeast cross-wall heading retained for site alignment; square base is visually aligned to adjacent former quarters/prison. Native lighthouse octagon is quantized, not a measured square wall bearing.

scope: Surviving1909 concrete tower with square base, octagonal tapered shaft/watchroom, gallery and current lantern/beacon/caged access ladder; narrow own footing/entry steps only. Separate former residences/ruins, prison and vaulted cistern excluded.
limitations: Historical inventory dimensions and dated local images do not certify current surveyed elevations, exact hidden openings or changed fixtures.
